finalProject.prompt: Explain how Lauryn Hill blended rap, soul, spirituality, and emotional truth to create one of the most influential albums in music history. Compare ONE Fugees-era track (‘Ready or Not’) with ONE Miseducation track (‘Ex-Factor’ or ‘Lost Ones’) and identify TWO modern artists who clearly show Lauryn Hill’s influence.
